path.screening_model: Saved-stackup first-order travel time; ideal reference planes and dielectric via travel

Screening timing is separate from verified section extraction; existing blockers remain applicable.

segments.screening_model: Ideal microstrip: adjacent copper assumed continuous reference; lateral copper and coupling omitted

edge_screen: Short relative to the entered edge (screen only)
delay_source: User-assumed effective permittivity over the complete resolved path
z0_source: User-assumed uniform line; discontinuities are not modeled

source.basis: Geometric reference coverage; local single-ended section model

receiver.basis: Geometric reference coverage; local single-ended section model

route_summary.scope: Section impedance range excludes unresolved sections and is not a uniform route Z0.

assumptions: Ordered RLC extractor sections cascaded as distributed lossy transmission lines; width changes retain their reflections.
Frequency-independent extracted DC copper R and quasi-static section L/C; ideal reference conductor.
Linear Thevenin source, explicit resistive receiver (blank means open) and user-entered receiver capacitance.
Periodic PRBS7 with equal causal linear ramps, ideal clock and no jitter; alignment uses summed geometric line delay.
Opening is sampled at 0.5 UI, not an optimized receiver sampling phase.
limitations: Not IBIS, LPDDR4 timing/ODT/training simulation, protocol compliance or a measured eye.
Skin/proximity effect, return-conductor resistance, dielectric loss/dispersion, roughness and coupled aggressors are not included.
Pads, packages, connectors and nonlinear clamps are not extracted; receiver C is an explicit assumption, not an IBIS value.
Finite PRBS7 and bounded sampled FFT can miss narrow peaks or worst-case longer patterns.
No eye mask, clock recovery, BER prediction or multi-conductor differential channel solve.
